data.body:
[P2] Preserve matching historical records in text destinations

Retained records from older exporters can still contain microsecond timestamps. A stored `2026-10-23T18:42:46.784500Z` previously matched `since: "2026-10-23T18:42:46.784119Z"`, but rounding the bound to `.785Z` now excludes it. Upgrading producers does not rewrite that history. For mixed-precision data, retrieve a sufficiently broad candidate set and compare timestamps at a common precision before applying the result limit. Restrict this fixed-width comparison to records guaranteed to use that format, and add historical-record regression coverage.
